{{Quote|Unless you sensitive artists have got any special requests, you're deployed with Aquila and Manka&mdash;two men riding with each CSF assault ship. Okay?|ARC-Captain Alpha-26, to Omega Squad|<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
'''Aquila Squad''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[unit]] that was part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After an unsuccessful [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Separatist attack]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="O66" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Aquila Squad, together with fellow commando [[Squad/Legends|squads]] [[Omega Squad|Omega]] and [[Manka Squad|Manka]] were scheduled to assist the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] in reestablishing law and order on the planet.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aquila Squad appeared in [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], the fourth installment of the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]]. The novel was written by [[Karen Traviss]] and released in [[2008]].<ref name="O66" />
